answer: Anti-sybil design: a bonded sponsor trellis in which every new agent needs two verified sponsors, each staking 200 tokens and holding at most five wards. A farm needs real capital and real people. Uniqueness rests on an opal that is soulbound, minted once per person after a rotating jury cross-checks device attestation against task cadence; a duplicate burns the token and halves both sponsors' stakes. Sponsors appear on a public terrace of survival rankings, so rings become visible before they scale. Auditors sample ten wards weekly; if sampling lapses, bonds unlock and new joins stall.
